lernapps.github.io.message:
feat: prepare a usage counter for the platform sites, never for the apps

## Intent

Find out whether the apps are used at all. The platform's own pages count their visits; the apps stay entirely free of tracking. Everything is prepared, so the counter only needs its GoatCounter code to go live.

## Key changes

- The home site serves a small own counter script as /lernapps-count.js. It sends the path of the page, and clicks on links marked data-la-count as events, to GoatCounter. It sends no query, title, referrer or screen size, and uses no cookies or localStorage.
- It counts nothing with Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track, in a pull request preview, or while the endpoint is empty. The endpoint is set in one place.
- The counter is not part of the shared site frame, because apps use the frame too. The home site adds it to all its own pages; /apps/, /docs/ and /tooling/ add the same tag in their own layouts.
- lernapps-check fails any site outside the four platform sites that carries the counter.
- The privacy notice has a section on the counter in German and English. It appears once the counter is on. "Nichts wird gesammelt" now reads "Die Apps sammeln nichts".

## Dependencies and side effects

- The catalog, tooling and docs add the counter in their own repos (apps ee5555a, tooling e2a59eb, docs 8ccaaa4).
